text: dsh-git-diff 是面向 DSH Web 的 Git 变更侧栏插件，在右侧栏增加 Git changes 标签。它通过 Host 路由读取当前 Session 工作区的 Git 状态，并在浏览器面板显示分支、变更路径和暂存标记。用户可展开路径，将 HEAD 与工作树内容并排比较，也可打开文件预览；面板会在显示、Agent 回合结束或手动刷新时更新。适合在 DSH 网页中检查尚未提交的代码改动。使用前需在 Session 执行环境安装 git 并确保它位于 PATH。

dsh-git-diff adds a Git changes tab to the DSH web sidebar. It shows the Session branch, changed paths and staged status. Expand a path to compare HEAD with the working tree or open its preview. It refreshes on display, after an agent turn, or on request. Git must be on PATH in Session environment.
想在 DSH 网页里直接看当前 Git 工作区改了哪些文件。
有没有办法在右侧栏查看当前分支和变更数量？
我想把未提交文件和 HEAD 版本并排对照。
能不能按文件展开 Git diff，并看清新增和删除的行？
DSH 里怎么快速打开有改动的文件预览？
让 DSH 在 Agent 一轮结束后自动刷新 Git 状态。
Show me the changed files in my current DSH workspace.
I want to compare an edited file with its HEAD version side by side.
dsh-git-diff 的功能「branch-status」：显示分支与变更列表。右侧栏打开 Git changes 标签后，插件读取当前 Session 工作区的 Git 状态，列出分支、变更路径、变更类型标记和暂存状态。
dsh-git-diff 的功能「side-by-side-diff」：并排比较文件差异。展开一条已变更路径后，界面显示 HEAD 与工作树的对照；新增、删除和修改内容以对齐行展示，过长或二进制文件会显示提示。
dsh-git-diff 的功能「refresh」：刷新工作区状态。面板可通过刷新按钮或侧栏命令更新，也会在标签显示及 Agent 回合结束时刷新当前 Session 的变更列表。
dsh-git-diff 的功能「open-preview」：打开变更文件预览。变更列表中的文件入口会调用侧栏资源预览；已删除文件不提供该入口。

dsh-git-diff README · dsh-git-diff：Adds a **Git changes** tab to the right Sidebar of the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) web UI (`dsh web`), next to the built-in Files and Terminal tabs.

dsh-git-diff README · dsh-git-diff：- Open it from the Sidebar guide. The header shows the current branch and how many paths changed.
- Changed paths are listed with `M` / `A` / `D` / `R` / `C` / `T` / `U` (untracked) / `!` (conflict) badges. Paths that are already staged are marked.
- Expand a path to compare it side by side (see [Diff view](#diff-view)). Use the arrow button to open the file in the Sidebar preview; deleted paths have no such button.
- The list refreshes when the tab becomes visible, when an agent turn finishes, and on the Sidebar refresh command or button.

dsh-git-diff README · dsh-git-diff：Version 1.x drew its own Files and History panels. DSH now ships both natively: the Files tab, and turn navigation in the chat. 2.0 therefore keeps only the git view and rebuilds it on the right-Sidebar tab API.
dsh-git-diff README · Diff view：An expanded path shows two aligned columns: `HEAD` on the left, the working tree on the right.

dsh-git-diff README · Diff view：- Each column has its own line numbers. Removed lines are red on the left, added lines are green on the right, and a changed line faces its replacement. A line with no counterpart leaves a blank cell on the other side.
- Three lines of context surround each change. Longer unchanged stretches fold into a single "N unchanged lines" row.
- A new or untracked file fills only the right column. A deleted file fills only the left column.
- Long lines wrap inside their column, so the view fits a narrow Sidebar.
- Binary files, and files where either side exceeds 512 KiB, show a note instead of a diff.

dsh-git-diff README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0` with the **web** profile.
- `git` on `PATH` in the Session's execution environment.

dsh-git-diff README · Installation：The package is a DeepSeek Harness bundle. Its `cordis.patch.yml` registers one row, which loads both the Host half (`lib/index.js`) and the browser half (`lib/client.js`).

```bash
dsh-git-diff README · from GitHub (pin a commit for reproducibility: ...#<commit-sha>)：dsh plugin --profile web add github:XYZ1024-alt/dsh-git-diff

The built JavaScript in `lib/` is committed, so installation does not run a build. Reload the page after installing. Remove the plugin with `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-git-diff`.

text: dsh-git-diff README · Security：The plugin registers two read-only GET routes, `/api/dsh-git-diff/status` and `/api/dsh-git-diff/diff`, as exact Fetch routes on DSH's shared `/api` channel. Before a request reaches them, DSH's Connection applies its Host/Origin trust checks and browser authentication, and only owner Peers get through.

dsh-git-diff README · Security：- Each request names a Session. Git runs only in that Session's working directory.
- The diff route returns content only for paths that `git status` currently reports as changed, and only inside the repository root.

dsh-git-diff README · Development：```bash
pnpm install
pnpm check   # typecheck (Host and client separately), Biome, build lib/
```

dsh-git-diff README · Development：| Path | Role |
|---|---|
| `src/contract.ts` | Zod schemas for the wire responses, shared by both halves |
| `src/routes.ts` | Route paths |
| `src/host/` | Host plugin: Session to working directory, git through `ctx.subprocess`, file reads through `ctx.fs` |
| `src/client/index.ts` | Browser plugin entry: tab type, guide entry, tab body registration |
| `src/client/GitChangesBody.tsx` | Tab body: branch header, change list, per-path diff loading |
| `src/client/split-diff.ts` | Side-by-side row model: local patches from `diff`, paired old/new lines, folded gaps |
| `src/client/SplitDiff.tsx` | Two-column diff renderer |
| `src/client/api.ts` | Browser adapter over the Host routes, parsed with the shared contract |
| `src/client/locales.ts` | English and Chinese dictionaries |
| `scripts/build.mjs` | esbuild: ESM Host bundle and client bundle in the DSH module-loader envelope, with CSS-module styles injected |

dsh-git-diff README · Development：The client bundle imports only from the Web shell's platform modules (`react`, `zod`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`, and so on). Everything else, including `swr` and `diff`, is bundled. The build fails when the client imports any other `@deepseek-ai/*` package at runtime.
